entity.name: OYO
entity.description:
OYO is a global platform that aims to empower entrepreneurs and small businesses with hotels and homes by providing full-stack technology products and services that aims to increase revenue and ease operations; bringing easy-to-book, affordable, and trusted accommodation to customers around the world. OYO offers 40+ integrated products and solutions to patrons who operate over 157K hotel and home storefronts in more than 35 countries including India, Europe, and Southeast Asia.

OYO was founded by 27-year-old Ritesh Agarwal, the first Asian resident to be accepted to the Thiel Fellowship (started by Paypal founder Peter Thiel).

OYO operates a unique business model that helps its patrons transform fragmented, unbranded and underutilized hospitality assets into branded, digitally-enabled storefronts with higher revenue generation potential and provides its customers with access to a broad range of high-quality storefronts at compelling price points. 

Owners and operators of over 157K storefronts use the OYO platform to manage all mission-critical aspects of their business operations. OYO’s comprehensive, full-stack technology suite integrates more than 40 products and services across digital sign-up and onboarding, revenue management, daily business management and D2C stacks into two flagship patron applications, Co-OYO and OYO OS. 

OYO customers can book storefronts through OYO’s own D2C channels and through indirect channels with third-party OTAs. The OYO App offers a variety of digital tools to guide customers throughout their journey, including discovery, seamless booking, pre-stay assistance, cancellations, digital check-ins as well as in-stay and post-stay services. With over 100 mn downloads, the OYO App was the 3rd most downloaded travel app in 2020. OYO Wizard, OYO’s loyalty program, has 9.2 million members and is the second largest loyalty program run by a travel or food brand in India, by subscriber base.

Today, over 60% of our hotels are leisure-focused destination resorts and urban lifestyle hotels and nearly 95% are independently managed.

Portara Companies is a luxury villa and hospitality platform built to acquire, operate, and scale a portfolio of international high-end short-term rental villas using hotel-grade standards and a tech-enabled operating model.

Our approach is designed to deliver the best of both worlds. Residential-style assets with long-term value characteristics, paired with hospitality-style revenue potential driven by premium nightly rates, service consistency, and professional operations.

Under the Portara Companies umbrella, we bring together three core functions:

Investment and Asset Oversight
We guide long-term strategy, asset selection, risk management, and performance monitoring across luxury villa real estate. The focus is disciplined decision-making, clear reporting, and long-horizon value creation grounded in real estate fundamentals and operational execution.

Villa Operations and Guest Experience
We run a hospitality-first operating playbook built for premium short-term rentals. That includes consistent service standards, quality control, property readiness, vendor coordination, and guest experience systems. The goal is to deliver a luxury stay that performs like a great hotel while preserving the privacy, space, and uniqueness of a private home.

Technology/Digital Infrastructure
We build and integrate modern systems that improve operational efficiency and clarity through dashboards, workflow automation, performance analytics, and digital tools that streamline the experience for stakeholders. We also explore emerging technologies such as blockchain and tokenization as optional capabilities to support transparency, automation, and future flexibility, without changing the underlying real estate and hospitality focus.

Portara Companies blends 40+ years of hospitality operating experience with a global luxury villa strategy and a digital-first mindset, bringing institutional process to a segment that has traditionally been fragmented and inconsistent.

FlipFlop is an online hotel reservation exchange platform that allows users to buy and/or sell hotel rooms between other users. A user can sell a hotel reservation that they booked with either a guarantee, or non-guarantee. FlipFlop gives sellers the opportunity to sell their unused hotel reservations and save money from cancellation fees. This creates a win-win situation for both parties because it can be used to offset the price of frequently changing travel plans, while give buyers great last minute deals on hotel rooms. 

FlipFlop is the first online hotel exchange platform that allows for “People Powered Pricing.” This means sellers can set their own prices for the hotel rooms they want to list.

Hotel customers are given peace of mind when booking a reservation with FlipFlop by giving them a safety net to offload their reservation if need be and providing the best customer service in the industry.

entity.name: Laasie
entity.description:
Laasie is the loyalty and direct booking platform built for modern hospitality brands.

We help hotels, resorts, management companies, vacation rentals, and travel brands turn guest engagement into measurable revenue through flexible, white label loyalty experiences that drive direct bookings, capture first party data, and increase repeat stays.

Unlike traditional loyalty systems built around one size fits all points programs, Laasie gives hospitality brands the Power of Choice, allowing guests to engage through instant rewards, perks, points, cashback, or a combination of all four.

Our platform powers loyalty across the entire guest journey through four core products:

Retain: A modern loyalty platform that drives enrollment, engagement, and repeat bookings through perks, points, cashback, tiers, referrals, and personalized rewards.

Convert: A direct booking conversion engine that incentivizes guests during the booking journey to reduce OTA dependence and increase direct revenue.

Acquire: A guest acquisition and first party data platform designed to capture emails, grow audiences, and fuel personalized marketing.

Flex: Flexible reward delivery tools for call centers, front desk teams, voice channels, service recovery, upsells, and guest engagement beyond the booking engine.

Laasie integrates across the hospitality ecosystem including booking engines, PMS platforms, CRMs, mobile apps, and call center environments. Our SDK also allows brands to embed loyalty directly into their existing mobile applications for a seamless guest experience.

Today, Laasie powers loyalty and rewards across thousands of hospitality properties, helping brands create more meaningful guest relationships while driving measurable commercial outcomes.

Own the guest relationship. Reward smarter. Grow direct.

entity.name: Graham Healthcare Capital
entity.description:
Headquartered in Nashville, TN, Graham Healthcare Capital (GHCC) provides permanent capital solutions to healthcare service and technology companies that have between $5-$75M in annual revenue and up to $10M in profit. GHCC has a differentiated approach that lies between a private equity buyout firm and a corporate strategic buyer. GHCC retains, backs, and aligns existing leadership and core principles, providing a supportive platform focused on long-term, sustainable growth.

GHCC leaders offer backgrounds and expertise in operations, value creation, and finance. They’ve built companies from the ground up and understand the importance of emphasizing culture, integrity, employee retention, and strategic investment overbuilding companies solely to maximize profitability in the short term.

Since GHCC holds companies indefinitely, our investment strategies are long-term in nature and focus on preserving the company's legacy. Founders continue to participate in the profitability of the company via distributions and typically retain a significant equity position in the company.

GHCC’s alignment strategy includes:
• low-leverage utilization
• no management fees
• no hurdle rates of returns or preferred capital that favors investors

Graham Healthcare Capital is part of the companies we invest in – not a misaligned equity investor or beholden to the competing priorities of a strategic buyer.
Unlike traditional private equity, we employ a low-leverage, buy-and-hold strategy, partnering with ownership teams over a longer-term investment horizon. This strategy allows for decision-making that is best for the company and its management.

    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.

THE PURSUIT OF HAPPINESS

JSH Hotels Collection is a leading hotel management group that manages a global portfolio of 18 independent and international hotels and resorts in Italy, Austria, and Switzerland. Ours is a dynamic, young and diversified company whose key factor for success is the respect for a precise scale of corporate values and a

properties.name: JSH Hotels & Resorts
properties.description:
THE PURSUIT OF HAPPINESS

JSH Hotels Collection is a leading hotel management group that manages a global portfolio of 18 independent and international hotels and resorts in Italy, Austria, and Switzerland. Ours is a dynamic, young and diversified company whose key factor for success is the respect for a precise scale of corporate values and a culture of travel that by necessity departs from people.
What does our guest look for when staying in our facilities? What do you expect? What are your needs, your expectations? How can we satisfy them? What can we and should we do if it is a disappointment?
Finding the right answer to these questions is the founding principle of our work. Our research is complex, because the needs are increasingly more demanding, multiple and specific, and the response must be appropriate, and cannot be based on market segments, but must be instead “on target"​, focusing on the individual person.
We all know that you are looking for more and more from your holiday; wellness and serenity, and to be able to break away from everyday life by immersing yourself in a relaxing and enjoyable dimension. Well-being can no longer come from generalist principles, or from flat and uniform standards. What people are looking for and what we want to offer is true well-being for everyone, even for those who have not been on vacation for a very long time. Expectations are diverse, for example for those who always enjoy fresh vegetable extract, or for the sportsman who wants to stay active on vacation. For the celiac baby who is gluten intolerant. For those who suffer from back pain and do not sleep well if the mattress is not rigid enough. For those who find the greatest achievement by reading a book under the stars or sipping a drink at sunset.
Our sense of hospitality is the answer to these questions. Or rather, it is the very essence of our research, which never stops and makes us so dynamic, fluid, and ever projected towards innovation and mindful of new trends.
The answer to these questions comes, every day, from the people who work in our hotels. From the chefs in the kitchen who spend their lives experimenting above a hot stove, to the reception staff who welcomes guests upon arrival. From the housekeeping staff, which makes the rooms perfect every morning, to the masseuse, who gives a moment of happiness through his hands. From the director, who is the “deus ex machina”, the ultimate problem solver of every area of the hotel, to the local coach, who focuses on opportunities outside of the hotel or resort to enable the guest to discover the splendor of the surrounding territories. Everyone, in his own way, works with one goal in mind: To meet the demands of the customer with a smile and to respond to needs and expectations, with promptness, sincerity and attentive care.
Thanks to our ten-year experience as operators in the hotel management industry, we have advanced skills that enable us to manage very different assets, diversifying our products and enhancing their special characteristics, from boutique hotels to congress centers, from resorts to luxury segment. And we do this in collaboration with the most prestigious international brands, such as Hilton, Marriott, Radisson Blu, Holiday Inn.

Our hotels provide experiences, emotions, well-being, and the discovery of the surrounding territories, cultures and traditions. We are promoters of a healthy lifestyle where sport, physical activity, good food, and personal care are indispensable. To ensure this, to succeed and maintain our leadership in the hospitality industry, we know we must focus on people, both inside and outside our company. There are over 1000 people who already work with us and contribute each day to our ambitious goals. And they will continue to grow. Our success is, above all, their success.

ANDREA CIGARINI
President & CEO JSH Hotels Collection

properties.name: Graham Healthcare Capital
properties.description:
Headquartered in Nashville, TN, Graham Healthcare Capital (GHCC) provides permanent capital solutions to healthcare service and technology companies that have between $5-$75M in annual revenue and up to $10M in profit. GHCC has a differentiated approach that lies between a private equity buyout firm and a corporate strategic buyer. GHCC retains, backs, and aligns existing leadership and core principles, providing a supportive platform focused on long-term, sustainable growth.

GHCC leaders offer backgrounds and expertise in operations, value creation, and finance. They’ve built companies from the ground up and understand the importance of emphasizing culture, integrity, employee retention, and strategic investment overbuilding companies solely to maximize profitability in the short term.

Since GHCC holds companies indefinitely, our investment strategies are long-term in nature and focus on preserving the company's legacy. Founders continue to participate in the profitability of the company via distributions and typically retain a significant equity position in the company.

GHCC’s alignment strategy includes:
• low-leverage utilization
• no management fees
• no hurdle rates of returns or preferred capital that favors investors

Graham Healthcare Capital is part of the companies we invest in – not a misaligned equity investor or beholden to the competing priorities of a strategic buyer.
Unlike traditional private equity, we employ a low-leverage, buy-and-hold strategy, partnering with ownership teams over a longer-term investment horizon. This strategy allows for decision-making that is best for the company and its management.

We help hotels, resorts, management companies, vacation rentals, and travel brands turn guest engagement into measurable revenue through flexible, white label loyalty experiences that drive direct bookings, capture first party data, and increase repeat stays.

Retain: A modern loyalty platform that drives enrollment, engagement, and repeat bookings through perks, points, cashback, tiers, referrals, and personalized rewards.

Convert: A direct booking conversion engine that incentivizes guests during the booking journey to reduce OTA dependence and increase direct revenue.

Acquire: A guest acquisition and first party data platform designed to capture emails, grow audiences, and fuel personalized marketing.

Flex: Flexible reward delivery tools for call centers, front desk teams, voice channels, service recovery, upsells, and guest engagement beyond the booking engine.

Laasie integrates across the hospitality ecosystem including booking engines, PMS platforms, CRMs, mobile apps, and call center environments. Our SDK also allows brands to embed loyalty directly into their existing mobile applications for a seamless guest experience.

Today, Laasie powers loyalty and rewards across thousands of hospitality properties, helping brands create more meaningful guest relationships while driving measurable commercial outcomes.

Own the guest relationship. Reward smarter. Grow direct.

entity.name: Zumi AI
entity.description:
Personalization and Loyalty, Redefined for Hospitality:

Zumi is reimagining how the world’s leading hospitality brands connect with their guests. We are building an intelligence platform for hospitality that powers personalized experiences, real-time service insights, and lasting loyalty.

Giving Super Powers to Hospitality staff:

Zumi’s intelligence, insights and recommendations flow directly into the tools staff already use: be it the restaurant POS, the front desk, concierge system and others. That means staff don’t need to learn a new system or change workflows. Instead, they’re armed with just the right information, at the right moment, to make every interaction feel personal.

Loyalty That Feels Human:

Zumi goes beyond guest intelligence to help premium hospitality groups deliver loyalty programs that truly resonate. Our rewards engine doesn’t rely on generic points or discounts. Instead, we identify every valued, regular guest (not just the ones who signed up to your loyalty program), assign status tiers, and deliver real time recognition and benefits directly via staff systems. 

The impact is powerful. With Zumi, operators see guests spending more, visiting more often, and forming deeper emotional connections with the brand.

Trusted by Global Leaders:

Already, Zumi powers tens of thousands of personalized interactions each month for some of the most prominent names in hospitality. Our early clients include COYA, the global luxury restaurant group and a five-star resort in Europe.

The Future of Guest Experience:

Hospitality is entering a new era where data and AI will amplify, not replace the human touch. Zumi is building the nervous system of this experience economy: intelligent, frictionless, and compounding in value with every use.

For hospitality leaders, this means stronger retention, higher guest spend, and loyalty programs that feel authentic. For guests, it means recognition, personalization, and memorable experiences at every touchpoint.

entity.name: JSH Hotels & Resorts
entity.description:
THE PURSUIT OF HAPPINESS

JSH Hotels Collection is a leading hotel management group that manages a global portfolio of 18 independent and international hotels and resorts in Italy, Austria, and Switzerland. Ours is a dynamic, young and diversified company whose key factor for success is the respect for a precise scale of corporate values and a culture of travel that by necessity departs from people.
What does our guest look for when staying in our facilities? What do you expect? What are your needs, your expectations? How can we satisfy them? What can we and should we do if it is a disappointment?
Finding the right answer to these questions is the founding principle of our work. Our research is complex, because the needs are increasingly more demanding, multiple and specific, and the response must be appropriate, and cannot be based on market segments, but must be instead “on target"​, focusing on the individual person.
We all know that you are looking for more and more from your holiday; wellness and serenity, and to be able to break away from everyday life by immersing yourself in a relaxing and enjoyable dimension. Well-being can no longer come from generalist principles, or from flat and uniform standards. What people are looking for and what we want to offer is true well-being for everyone, even for those who have not been on vacation for a very long time. Expectations are diverse, for example for those who always enjoy fresh vegetable extract, or for the sportsman who wants to stay active on vacation. For the celiac baby who is gluten intolerant. For those who suffer from back pain and do not sleep well if the mattress is not rigid enough. For those who find the greatest achievement by reading a book under the stars or sipping a drink at sunset.
Our sense of hospitality is the answer to these questions. Or rather, it is the very essence of our research, which never stops and makes us so dynamic, fluid, and ever projected towards innovation and mindful of new trends.
The answer to these questions comes, every day, from the people who work in our hotels. From the chefs in the kitchen who spend their lives experimenting above a hot stove, to the reception staff who welcomes guests upon arrival. From the housekeeping staff, which makes the rooms perfect every morning, to the masseuse, who gives a moment of happiness through his hands. From the director, who is the “deus ex machina”, the ultimate problem solver of every area of the hotel, to the local coach, who focuses on opportunities outside of the hotel or resort to enable the guest to discover the splendor of the surrounding territories. Everyone, in his own way, works with one goal in mind: To meet the demands of the customer with a smile and to respond to needs and expectations, with promptness, sincerity and attentive care.
Thanks to our ten-year experience as operators in the hotel management industry, we have advanced skills that enable us to manage very different assets, diversifying our products and enhancing their special characteristics, from boutique hotels to congress centers, from resorts to luxury segment. And we do this in collaboration with the most prestigious international brands, such as Hilton, Marriott, Radisson Blu, Holiday Inn.

Our hotels provide experiences, emotions, well-being, and the discovery of the surrounding territories, cultures and traditions. We are promoters of a healthy lifestyle where sport, physical activity, good food, and personal care are indispensable. To ensure this, to succeed and maintain our leadership in the hospitality industry, we know we must focus on people, both inside and outside our company. There are over 1000 people who already work with us and contribute each day to our ambitious goals. And they will continue to grow. Our success is, above all, their success.

ANDREA CIGARINI
President & CEO JSH Hotels Collection

Our goal is to create premium total shareholder returns by employing rigorous capital allocation and innovative asset management, in conjunction with a balance sheet that preserves strategic and financial flexibility, to relentlessly drive risk-adjusted free cash flow and equity value per share. 

Since 2010, we have repositioned our portfolio through the acquisition of nearly $3 billion of urban and resort hotels that align with our strategic goals while disposing of more than $1 billion in non-core hotels. These acquisitions have increase our exposure to unique destination markets such as Sedona, Lake Tahoe, Sonoma, Key West, and Charleston. Today, over 60% of our hotels are leisure-focused destination resorts and urban lifestyle hotels and nearly 95% are independently managed. 

DiamondRock is proud to named Global Listed Sector Leader by the Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark ("GRESB"), achieving the top position in the Hotel Sector for the fifth consecutive year, for its outstanding corporate responsibility program.

Headquartered in Nashville, TN, Graham Healthcare Capital (GHCC) provides permanent capital solutions to healthcare service and technology companies that have between $5-$75M in annual revenue and up to $10M in profit. GHCC has a differentiated approach that lies between a private equity buyout firm and a corporate strategic buyer. GHCC retains, backs, and aligns existing leadership and core principles, providing a supportive platform focused on long-term, sustainable growth.

GHCC leaders offer backgrounds and expertise in operations, value creation, and finance. They’ve built companies from the ground up and understand the importance of emphasizing culture, integrity, employee retention, and strategic investment overbuilding companies solely to maximize profitability in the short term.

Since GHCC holds companies indefinitely, our investment strategies are long-term in nature and focus on preserving the company's legacy. Founders continue to participate in the profitability of the company via distributions and typically retain a significant equity position in the company.

GHCC’s alignment strategy includes:
• low-leverage utilization
• no management fees
• no hurdle rates of returns or preferred capital that favors investors

Graham Healthcare Capital is part of the companies we invest in – not a misaligned equity investor or beholden to the competing priorities of a strategic buyer.
Unlike traditional private equity, we employ a low-leverage, buy-and-hold strategy, partnering with ownership teams over a longer-term investment horizon. This strategy allows for decision-making that is best for the company and its management.

You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.
  - Shopify ↔ an online-store/e-commerce platform: true.
  - Shopify ↔ a payment processor with no storefront platform: false.
  - Grab ↔ a ride-hailing marketplace: true.
  - Grab ↔ a traditional car-rental operator with no on-demand marketplace: false.
  - Rippling ↔ a smaller HRIS/payroll platform: true.
  - Rippling ↔ device-security software for mobile workers: false.
  - Brex ↔ a corporate-card and spend-management platform: true.
  - Brex ↔ consumer personal-finance budgeting software: false.
  - OpenAI ↔ a foundation-model/API company: true.
  - OpenAI ↔ a consultancy that implements AI tools for clients: false.
  - Datadog ↔ an application-performance-monitoring and observability platform: true.
  - Datadog ↔ a generic IT consulting firm: false.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ an endpoint-security platform: true.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ a general-purpose IT monitoring tool with no security product: false.
  - Procore ↔ construction project-management software: true.
  - Procore ↔ a construction contractor: false.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ field-service management software for trades businesses: true.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ a plumbing company that uses field-service software: false.
  - Teladoc ↔ a virtual-care/telehealth platform: true.
  - Teladoc ↔ a health-insurance carrier with no telehealth product: false.
  - Veeva ↔ life-sciences CRM or clinical-operations software: true.
  - Veeva ↔ a generic CRM with no life-sciences focus: false.

properties.name: Landingplace Hotels
properties.description:
Landingplace Hotels™ is a next-generation hotel franchisor built by experienced hospitality operators to help hotel owners unlock stronger performance from existing assets.

Our brands are designed specifically for hotel conversions and flexible development, giving owners a modern alternative to rigid brand standards, costly renovations, and inefficient operating models often required by traditional hotel chains.

Landingplace currently offers two brands designed for different guest stay patterns:

🛋️ Landingplace Suites™
An extended-stay brand designed for guests staying for longer periods, including relocations, project assignments, remote work, and long-term travel.

🛏️ Landingplace Select™
A modern midscale select-service brand designed for shorter stays of 1–5 nights, including business travel, events, and weekend leisure.

Both brands are built around a simple philosophy: owner economics matter.

Instead of forcing expensive upgrades or rigid brand standards, Landingplace focuses on operational efficiency, flexible design, and technology that allows hotels to operate smarter.

Key differences from traditional hotel brands include:

• Conversion-friendly standards that preserve existing property features and reduce renovation costs
• Technology-enabled operations that streamline workflows and reduce staffing requirements
• Optional services such as housekeeping and breakfast that allow owners to convert traditional cost centers into revenue opportunities
• Local character and neighborhood integration that help each property deliver a more authentic guest experience

Landingplace was founded by hospitality leaders with decades of experience across global brands including Marriott, Hilton, Wyndham, IHG, and Starwood, as well as major hotel ownership and management companies.

# Cogent Equity

Cogent Equity is a Investment Banking company. Cogent Equity helps owners of exceptional businesses navigate the sale process with clarity and firsthand experience. They focus on representing the true value of what you have built and securing the right buyer, on the right terms. Their focus includes market positioning, operations, customer relationships, reputation, and growth potential, factors that build buyer confidence and increase sale price. Cogent Equity employs 2 people (+50.0% YoY, +1 person), founded in 2001. Headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States.

## A

properties.name: Cogent Equity
properties.description:
Most transaction risk isn’t created during a sale process - it’s exposed by it.
 
By the time a business goes to market, many of the factors that determine value and deal certainty are already in place. We work with business owners and their advisors to evaluate those factors before the market does.
 
At Cogent Equity, we represent a limited number of companies with $1M to $10M in adjusted EBITDA, typically with long operating histories and strong underlying performance. Our focus is not just on running a process, but on ensuring the business is positioned to succeed in one.
 
This work often begins before a sale is imminent. We evaluate the business the way a sophisticated buyer would - identifying value constraints, aligning expectations, and addressing issues that would otherwise surface during diligence.
 
For advisors, the situations where it tends to be most useful to involve us are:
 
 - An owner is beginning to consider a sale in the next 1–3 years 
 - Valuation expectations are unclear or misaligned 
 - There are known or suspected issues that could impact a transaction 
 
Our perspective is shaped by firsthand experience as owners , operators, buyers, and sellers across nine different industries - allowing me to evaluate businesses the way a sophisticated buyer actually would.
 
While much of our work begins before a sale, we also represent owners through a structured, buyer-focused transaction process when the timing is right.
 
The objective is not just the right deal, but the right buyer - and a process that holds together from start to finish.

Our brands are designed specifically for hotel conversions and flexible development, giving owners a modern alternative to rigid brand standards, costly renovations, and inefficient operating models often required by traditional hotel chains.

Landingplace currently offers two brands designed for different guest stay patterns:

🛋️ Landingplace Suites™
An extended-stay brand designed for guests staying for longer periods, including relocations, project assignments, remote work, and long-term travel.

🛏️ Landingplace Select™
A modern midscale select-service brand designed for shorter stays of 1–5 nights, including business travel, events, and weekend leisure.

Both brands are built around a simple philosophy: owner economics matter.

Instead of forcing expensive upgrades or rigid brand standards, Landingplace focuses on operational efficiency, flexible design, and technology that allows hotels to operate smarter.

Key differences from traditional hotel brands include:

• Conversion-friendly standards that preserve existing property features and reduce renovation costs
• Technology-enabled operations that streamline workflows and reduce staffing requirements
• Optional services such as housekeeping and breakfast that allow owners to convert traditional cost centers into revenue opportunities
• Local character and neighborhood integration that help each property deliver a more authentic guest experience

Landingplace was founded by hospitality leaders with decades of experience across global brands including Marriott, Hilton, Wyndham, IHG, and Starwood, as well as major hotel ownership and management companies.

Learn more at www.landingplacehotels.com and www.landingplacefranchising.com

Hashwani Hotels Limited was incorporated as a private limited company in 1972 and was subsequently converted into a public limited company in 1974.

The Company is primarily engaged in the hospitality business in Pakistan and carries the franchise of International “Marriott” chain. It owns and operates Marriot Hotels in Islamabad and Karachi, and Zaver Pearl Continental hotel in Gwadar. It employs over 1,400 employees at different locations.

The company commenced its commercial operations in 1978, with the launch of Holiday Inn Islamabad under the franchise agreement with Bass Europeans, Netherlands. In an effort to expand its operations, HHL launched Holiday Inn Karachi, in 1981.

After more than a decade of successful operations, HHL approached the Marriott Worldwide Corporation USA in order to negotiate the franchise to own and operate the Marriott chain of hotels in Pakistan. Based upon their successful experience of managing foreign hotel franchises, HHL was awarded the franchise to own and operate the Marriott chain of hotels in Pakistan in 1992, under franchise agreement.

As a part of Marriott Hotel Network, HHL has access to the Marriott International Reservation System (MARSHA) for easy access to any Marriott Worldwide Hotel and travel agents worldwide. Both the hotels are renowned for their ideal locations, décor and friendly atmosphere. The hotels have a tradition of continuous product development, service improvement and upgrading of operating standards, excelling the expectations of their guests.

entity.name: Cogent Equity
entity.description:
Most transaction risk isn’t created during a sale process - it’s exposed by it.
 
By the time a business goes to market, many of the factors that determine value and deal certainty are already in place. We work with business owners and their advisors to evaluate those factors before the market does.
 
At Cogent Equity, we represent a limited number of companies with $1M to $10M in adjusted EBITDA, typically with long operating histories and strong underlying performance. Our focus is not just on running a process, but on ensuring the business is positioned to succeed in one.
 
This work often begins before a sale is imminent. We evaluate the business the way a sophisticated buyer would - identifying value constraints, aligning expectations, and addressing issues that would otherwise surface during diligence.
 
For advisors, the situations where it tends to be most useful to involve us are:
 
 - An owner is beginning to consider a sale in the next 1–3 years 
 - Valuation expectations are unclear or misaligned 
 - There are known or suspected issues that could impact a transaction 
 
Our perspective is shaped by firsthand experience as owners , operators, buyers, and sellers across nine different industries - allowing me to evaluate businesses the way a sophisticated buyer actually would.
 
While much of our work begins before a sale, we also represent owners through a structured, buyer-focused transaction process when the timing is right.
 
The objective is not just the right deal, but the right buyer - and a process that holds together from start to finish.

entity.name: Zumi AI
entity.description:
Personalization and Loyalty, Redefined for Hospitality:

Zumi is reimagining how the world’s leading hospitality brands connect with their guests. We are building an intelligence platform for hospitality that powers personalized experiences, real-time service insights, and lasting loyalty.

Giving Super Powers to Hospitality staff:

Zumi’s intelligence, insights and recommendations flow directly into the tools staff already use: be it the restaurant POS, the front desk, concierge system and others. That means staff don’t need to learn a new system or change workflows. Instead, they’re armed with just the right information, at the right moment, to make every interaction feel personal.

Loyalty That Feels Human:

Zumi goes beyond guest intelligence to help premium hospitality groups deliver loyalty programs that truly resonate. Our rewards engine doesn’t rely on generic points or discounts. Instead, we identify every valued, regular guest (not just the ones who signed up to your loyalty program), assign status tiers, and deliver real time recognition and benefits directly via staff systems. 

The impact is powerful. With Zumi, operators see guests spending more, visiting more often, and forming deeper emotional connections with the brand.

Trusted by Global Leaders:

Already, Zumi powers tens of thousands of personalized interactions each month for some of the most prominent names in hospitality. Our early clients include COYA, the global luxury restaurant group and a five-star resort in Europe.

The Future of Guest Experience:

Hospitality is entering a new era where data and AI will amplify, not replace the human touch. Zumi is building the nervous system of this experience economy: intelligent, frictionless, and compounding in value with every use.

For hospitality leaders, this means stronger retention, higher guest spend, and loyalty programs that feel authentic. For guests, it means recognition, personalization, and memorable experiences at every touchpoint.

You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.
  - Shopify ↔ an online-store/e-commerce platform: true.
  - Shopify ↔ a payment processor with no storefront platform: false.
  - Grab ↔ a ride-hailing marketplace: true.
  - Grab ↔ a traditional car-rental operator with no on-demand marketplace: false.
  - Rippling ↔ a smaller HRIS/payroll platform: true.
  - Rippling ↔ device-security software for mobile workers: false.
  - Brex ↔ a corporate-card and spend-management platform: true.
  - Brex ↔ consumer personal-finance budgeting software: false.
  - OpenAI ↔ a foundation-model/API company: true.
  - OpenAI ↔ a consultancy that implements AI tools for clients: false.
  - Datadog ↔ an application-performance-monitoring and observability platform: true.
  - Datadog ↔ a generic IT consulting firm: false.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ an endpoint-security platform: true.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ a general-purpose IT monitoring tool with no security product: false.
  - Procore ↔ construction project-management software: true.
  - Procore ↔ a construction contractor: false.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ field-service management software for trades businesses: true.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ a plumbing company that uses field-service software: false.
  - Teladoc ↔ a virtual-care/telehealth platform: true.
  - Teladoc ↔ a health-insurance carrier with no telehealth product: false.
  - Veeva ↔ life-sciences CRM or clinical-operations software: true.
  - Veeva ↔ a generic CRM with no life-sciences focus: false.
